comparison.objective: Seat and wrench-tighten a positive battery clamp on its tapered post.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring-loaded clamp seated while turning a nut with a wrench.
comparison.success_condition: Clamp seated within gap/alignment limits, nut turned 75–360°, lug aligned, tools and hands clear, stable 1 s.
comparison.reason: This tests sustained seating plus rotary fastening. The candidate tests impact-driven notch fracture with a coaxial mandrel, followed by recovery of four free tangs.
